tables: The research involves no more than minimal risk to the study participants. This means that the potential harm to the participants is no greater than that encountered in everyday life.

The research involves the use of existing data or minimal collection of new data. This means that the data has already been collected for other purposes or that the new data collection is minimal in scope and intrusiveness.
The research does not involve interventions or interactions with study participants. This means that the participants are not subjected to any experimental procedures or changes to their usual care.
